item.title: Hezbollah rejects ceasefire deal agreed on by Israel and Lebanon
item.description: The U.N. peacekeeping mission for Lebanon, known as UNIFIL, said one peacekeeper was killed and others were wounded when they came under mortar fire in southeastern Lebanon.

item.title: Senate to start debate on ICE funding. And, Israel and Lebanon agree to ceasefire
item.description: Senate Republicans are moving forward on a bill to fund immigration enforcement through the end of Trump's term. And, Israel and Lebanon have agreed to a ceasefire that could aid in ending the war in Iran.

item.title: NTSB says United jet was too slow and too low in Newark landing accident
item.description: Federal investigators say the captain flying the United 767 from Italy was too slow and too low before landing last month at Newark, N.J. The jet struck a light pole, damaging a truck on the turnpike.

item.title: Republicans' sweeping election overhaul fails in the Senate
item.description: The SAVE America Act, a far-reaching Republican election overhaul that President Trump said should be his congressional allies' top priority, has failed in the Senate.
